tools.name: list_tax_authority_releases
tools.description: Discover supported years, forms, versions, statuses, capabilities, and limitations before selecting a release.

tools.name: get_tax_authority_release
tools.description: Return a supported Form BE or Form B release, its official sources, validation result, review status, and known limitations.

tools.name: search_tax_authority
tools.description: Search cited Form BE or Form B rules by topic, field ID, rule ID, or TaxBrain category. Returns official source records with every match.

tools.name: prepare_be_2025_draft
tools.description: Compile reviewed taxpayer inputs and a deterministic TaxBrain relief evaluation into source-linked Form BE fields. This tool never stores data or submits to MyTax, and output remains review-gated.

tools.name: assess_form_b_2025_readiness
tools.description: Check whether the source records, finalised accounts, official worksheets, and conditional schedules needed for manual Form B preparation are ready. This does not calculate or submit Form B.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tax_authority_release · Private data: search_tax_authority, assess_form_b_2025_readiness · Public sink: assess_form_b_2025_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tax_authority_release · Private data: search_tax_authority, assess_form_b_2025_readiness · Public sink: assess_form_b_2025_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
